_comment: How the spend commitment draws down, copied from the org's own QB-MTY-CMT sample (SOQL 2026-10-07): a Commit-type grant on the Currency resource, and a product-level policy pointing at a UsageCommitmentPolicy. No Anchor product and no UsagePrdGrantBindingPolicy are involved: those exist only on Anchor products in the org. The Pack products are bound to the balance at contract time (UsageCmtAssetRelatedObj), not in the catalog. UNTESTED ASSUMPTION: Quantity 1 per unit scales with the quote quantity, so a line of 201262.83 units grants 201262.83 EUR. The WOLT-2026 acceptance quote decides. OverageChargeable is a v66-only field on the grant (README landmine).
